en: Sura 23: Al-Mu'minun
ja: 第23章 信者たち章

p.src: 23:1  The believers have attained true success:

en: The believers have attained true success:
ja: 信仰者たちは、確かに成功する。
u.src: 23:1  The believers have attained true success:

p.src: 23:2  those who humble themselves in their prayers,

en: those who humble themselves in their prayers,
ja: （彼らは、）その礼拝において、恭順[1]な者たち。
u.src: 23:2  those who humble themselves in their prayers,

ja: [1]　「恭順」については、雌牛章４５の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:3  and those who turn away from all that is vain,

en: and those who turn away from all that is vain,
ja: また戯言[1]から背を向ける者たち。
u.src: 23:3  and those who turn away from all that is vain,

ja: [1]　「戯言」とは、そこにいかなる善も認められないような言動のこと（ムヤッサル３４2頁参照）。禁じられた物事であれば尚更（なおさら）である（アッ＝サァディー５４７頁参照）。

p.src: 23:4  and those who give zakah[1],

en: and those who give zakah[1],
ja: また浄財*を実行する[1]者たち。
u.src: 23:4  and those who give zakah[1],

en: [1] Zakah (lit.,) purification and growth. Paying alms purifies and increases wealth.
ja: [1]　物質的な浄財*だけでなく、自分自身を悪い品性や悪行から清めることも含むとされている（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 23:5  and those who guard their sexual desires[2],

en: and those who guard their sexual desires[2],
ja: また、自らの陰部を（禁じられた物事[1]から）守る者たち。
u.src: 23:5  and those who guard their sexual desires[2],

en: [2] i.e., illegal sexual acts.
ja: [1]　この「禁じられた物事」については、御光章３０の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:6  except with their wives or slave women they may own, for then they are free of blame.

en: except with their wives or slave women they may own, for then they are free of blame.
ja: 但し、自分の妻たち、あるいは自分の右手が所有するもの（奴隷*女性）は別で、本当に彼ら（合法な物事だけを行う者たち）は咎められるものではない。
u.src: 23:6  except with their wives or slave women they may own, for then they are free of blame.

p.src: 23:7  But whoever seeks anything beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.

en: But whoever seeks anything beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.
ja: そして誰であろうとそれ以上を欲する者、それらの者たちこそは（アッラー*の法の）違反者なのだ。
u.src: 23:7  But whoever seeks anything beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.

p.src: 23:8  And those who are faithful to their trusts and pledges,

en: And those who are faithful to their trusts and pledges,
ja: また、自らの信託と、自分の契約を厳守する[1]者たち。
u.src: 23:8  And those who are faithful to their trusts and pledges,

ja: [1]　アッラー*がしもべに義務づけた信託と、財産や秘密に関することなど、人間同士の信託を守ること。また、契約についても同様（アッ＝サァディー５４７頁参照）。雌牛章2７の訳注も参照。

p.src: 23:9  and those who properly observe their prayers.

en: and those who properly observe their prayers.
ja: また、自分自身の礼拝を固守する者たち。
u.src: 23:9  and those who properly observe their prayers.

p.src: 23:10  Such will be the inheritors,

en: Such will be the inheritors,
ja: それらの者たちこそは、（天国の）相続人[1]である。
u.src: 23:10  Such will be the inheritors,

ja: [1]　「相続人」、およびアーヤ*11の「引き継ぐ」という表現については、マルヤム*章６３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:11  who will inherit Paradise[3]; they will abide therein forever.

en: who will inherit Paradise[3]; they will abide therein forever.
ja: （彼らは、）フィルダウス[1]を引き継ぐ者たち。彼らはそこに、永遠に留まる者たちとなる。
u.src: 23:11  who will inherit Paradise[3]; they will abide therein forever.

en: [3] Al-Firdaws: the highest rank in Paradise.
ja: [1]　「フィルダウス」とは、天国で最も高く、最も中心部に位置する楽園のこと。その真上には、アッラーの御座（みくら）がある（アル＝ブハーリー2７９０参照）。

p.src: 23:12  We created man[4] from an extract of clay,

en: We created man[4] from an extract of clay,
ja: われら*は確かに人間（の父祖アーダム*）を、泥土より抽出した物から創った[1]。
u.src: 23:12  We created man[4] from an extract of clay,

en: [4] i.e., Adam (عليه السلام).
ja: [1]　アル＝ヒジュル章2６の訳注も参照。人間の創造の変遷（へんせん）については、巡礼章５も参照。

p.src: 23:13  then We placed him as a sperm-drop[5] in a safe place,

en: then We placed him as a sperm-drop[5] in a safe place,
ja: それから、われら*はそれ（人間）を精液の一滴として、しっかりとした定着場[1]に設えた。
u.src: 23:13  then We placed him as a sperm-drop[5] in a safe place,

en: [5] i.e., a zygote.
ja: [1]　「しっかりとした定着場」とは、子宮のこと（アッ＝サァディー５４８頁参照）。

p.src: 23:14  then We made the sperm drop into a clinging clot, then We made the clinging clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We developed it into another creation[6]. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.

en: then We made the sperm drop into a clinging clot, then We made the clinging clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We developed it into another creation[6]. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.
ja: それから、その一滴の精液から一塊の凝血を創り、その一塊の凝血から一個の肉塊を創り、その一個の肉塊から骨を創り、そしてその骨に肉をかぶせ、それから（そこに魂を吹き込み、）別の創造（物）として、それを創り上げた。最善の創造者であられるアッラー*は、祝福に溢れたお方よ。
u.src: 23:14  then We made the sperm drop into a clinging clot, then We made the clinging clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We developed it into another creation[6]. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.

en: [6] After breathing the spirit into the embryo.

p.src: 23:15  Then after that you will surely die,

en: Then after that you will surely die,
ja: それから本当にあなた方は、その後、まさに死に行く身なのだ。
u.src: 23:15  Then after that you will surely die,

p.src: 23:16  then on the Day of Resurrection, you will surely be resurrected.

en: then on the Day of Resurrection, you will surely be resurrected.
ja: それから本当に、あなた方は復活の日*、蘇らされるのである。
u.src: 23:16  then on the Day of Resurrection, you will surely be resurrected.

p.src: 23:17  We have created above you seven levels [of heaven], and We have never been unaware of Our creation.

en: We have created above you seven levels [of heaven], and We have never been unaware of Our creation.
ja: われら*は確かに、あなた方の上に七つの重なったもの（天）を創り上げた[1]。そしてわれら*はもとより、創造に関して迂闊だったわけではない[2]。
u.src: 23:17  We have created above you seven levels [of heaven], and We have never been unaware of Our creation.

ja: [1]　ヌーフ*章1５も参照。 [2]　つまり天が崩れ落ちることで、人々が滅んでしまわないようにすることにおいて、迂闊ではあられない。あるいは、被造物の福利と保護において、迂闊ではあられない（アル＝クルトゥビー12：111参照）。

p.src: 23:18  We send down water from the sky in due measure and cause it to stay in the earth, and We are surely able to take it away.

en: We send down water from the sky in due measure and cause it to stay in the earth, and We are surely able to take it away.
ja: また、われら*は天から（雨）水を適度に下し、それを大地に留まらせた。そして実にわれら*は、それを消し去ってしまうことも、確実に出来るのである。
u.src: 23:18  We send down water from the sky in due measure and cause it to stay in the earth, and We are surely able to take it away.

p.src: 23:19  With this [water] We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are many fruits from which you eat,

en: With this [water] We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are many fruits from which you eat,
ja: そしてわれら*はそれ（水）によって、あなた方のためにナツメヤシや葡萄の園を設えた。そこには、あなた方のための豊富な果実があり、あなた方はそこから食べるのである。
u.src: 23:19  With this [water] We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are many fruits from which you eat,

p.src: 23:20  and [olive] tree that grows at Mount Sinai, producing oil and condiments for those who eat.

en: and [olive] tree that grows at Mount Sinai, producing oil and condiments for those who eat.
ja: また、シナイ山から生える木[1]を（設えた）。それは油と、（それを）食する者たちへの味付け（をもたらす果実）と共に、生育する。
u.src: 23:20  and [olive] tree that grows at Mount Sinai, producing oil and condiments for those who eat.

ja: [1]　この「木」は、オリーブの木（ムヤッサル３４３頁参照）。シナイ山、と限定されているのは、それがシャーム地方（現在のシリア、パレスチナ周辺地域）特産であるため （アッ＝サァディー５４９頁参照）。

p.src: 23:21  And there is certainly a lesson for you in livestock animals. We provide you with a drink out of what they have in their bellies, and for you there are many benefits in them, and from their [meat] you eat,

en: And there is certainly a lesson for you in livestock animals. We provide you with a drink out of what they have in their bellies, and for you there are many benefits in them, and from their [meat] you eat,
ja: また本当に家畜[1]には、あなた方に対しての教示がある。われら*はその腹部にあるもの[2]から、あなた方に飲ませる。そこ（家畜）にはあなた方にとっての多くの利益[3]があり、またあなた方は、そこから食する。
u.src: 23:21  And there is certainly a lesson for you in livestock animals. We provide you with a drink out of what they have in their bellies, and for you there are many benefits in them, and from their [meat] you eat,

ja: [1]　「家畜」については、食卓章1「家畜獣」の訳注を参照。 [2]　つまり、乳のこと（ムヤッサル３４３頁参照） 。蜜蜂章６６も参照。 [3]　具体的な利益の例については、蜜蜂章５－８、８０も参照。

p.src: 23:22  and on them and on boats you are carried.

en: and on them and on boats you are carried.
ja: そしてあなた方は、それ（家畜）と、船の上に（載って）運ばれる。
u.src: 23:22  and on them and on boats you are carried.

p.src: 23:23  We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”

en: We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”
ja: われら*は確かに、ヌーフ*をその民へと遣わした。そして彼は言った。「我が民よ、アッラー*を崇拝*せよ。あなた方には、かれの外に、崇拝*すべきいかなるものもないのだから。一体、あなた方は（アッラー*に逆らい、）畏れ*ないのか？」
u.src: 23:23  We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”

p.src: 23:24  The disbelieving chiefs of his people said, “This is only a man like yourselves who wants to be superior to you. If Allah had willed, He could have sent down angels. We have not heard such a thing from our forefathers.

en: The disbelieving chiefs of his people said, “This is only a man like yourselves who wants to be superior to you. If Allah had willed, He could have sent down angels. We have not heard such a thing from our forefathers.
ja: 彼の民の内の不信仰な有力者らは（人々に向かって、）言った。「これは（預言者*を主張することによって、）あなた方に優越しようとする、あなた方同様の一人の人間に過ぎない。そして、もしアッラー*が（使徒を下すことを）お望みならば、天使*たちを下したであろう[1]。私たちはこのようなことを、私たちの昔のご先祖様（の時代）において、聞いたことはなかったぞ。
u.src: 23:24  The disbelieving chiefs of his people said, “This is only a man like yourselves who wants to be superior to you. If Allah had willed, He could have sent down angels. We have not heard such a thing from our forefathers.

ja: [1]　家畜章111、アル＝ヒジュル章1４－1５、夜の旅章９３も参照。

p.src: 23:25  He is just a madman, so bear with him for a while[7].”

en: He is just a madman, so bear with him for a while[7].”
ja: 彼は憑き物がついた、一人の男に過ぎない[1]。ならば（彼が正気を取り戻すか、死ぬかするまで）、しばらく彼のことを見守っておけ」。
u.src: 23:25  He is just a madman, so bear with him for a while[7].”

en: [7] Perhaps he may recover from his insanity or his affair may become clear to people.
ja: [1]　アル＝ヒジュラ章６「憑かれた者」に関する訳注も参照。

p.src: 23:26  Noah said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”

en: Noah said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”
ja: 彼（ヌーフ*）は、申し上げた。「我が主*よ、彼らが私を嘘つき呼ばわりしますゆえ、私をお助け下さい」。[1]
u.src: 23:26  Noah said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”

ja: [1]　月章1０、ヌーフ*章2６－2７も参照。

p.src: 23:27  So We inspired him [saying], “Make the Ark under Our Eyes and according to Our directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts with water[8], take on board a pair of each species and your family, except those against whom the decree has already been passed. And do not plead with Me concerning those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”

en: So We inspired him [saying], “Make the Ark under Our Eyes and according to Our directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts with water[8], take on board a pair of each species and your family, except those against whom the decree has already been passed. And do not plead with Me concerning those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
ja: それでわれら*は、彼に（こう）啓示した。「われら*の眼差しのもと[1]、われら*の啓示によって[2]、船を造れ。そしてわれら*の命令が到来し、焼き窯が噴き出した[3]ら、全て（の生き物）から一つがいずつと、あなたの家族を、そこに乗り込ませよ。但し、彼らの内、既に（懲罰の）言葉が定められていた者[4]は別である。そして、不正*を働いていた者たちのこと[5]で、（その救いを求めて）私に話しかけるのではない。本当に彼らは、溺れ死ぬことになる者たちなのだから。
u.src: 23:27  So We inspired him [saying], “Make the Ark under Our Eyes and according to Our directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts with water[8], take on board a pair of each species and your family, except those against whom the decree has already been passed. And do not plead with Me concerning those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”

en: [8] Or the fountains of the earth gush forth.
ja: [1]　「眼差しのもと」については、ター・ハー章３９とその訳注を参照。 [2]　「われら*の啓示によって」については、フード*章３７の訳注を参照。 [3]　「焼き窯が噴き出した」については、フード*章４０の訳注を参照。 [4]　「既に（懲罰の）言葉が定められた者」については、フード*章４０の訳注を参照。 [5]　この具体的内容については、フード*章３７の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:28  Then when you and those who are with you have embarked on the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”

en: Then when you and those who are with you have embarked on the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
ja: それで、あなたと、あなたと共にいる者たちが船に（無事）乗った[1]なら、（こう）言うのだ。『私たちを不正*者である民から救って下さったアッラー*に、全ての称賛*あれ』」。
u.src: 23:28  Then when you and those who are with you have embarked on the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”

ja: [1]　彼らが船に乗ってからの出来事は、フード*章４2－４８に詳しい。

p.src: 23:29  And say: “My Lord, make my landing a blessed landing, for You provide the best landing’”.

en: And say: “My Lord, make my landing a blessed landing, for You provide the best landing’”.
ja: また、言うのだ。「我が主*よ、私を祝福多き場所へと到着させて下さい。あなたは、最善の場に到着させて下さるお方です」。
u.src: 23:29  And say: “My Lord, make my landing a blessed landing, for You provide the best landing’”.

p.src: 23:30  Indeed, there are signs in this, and We always put people to the test.

en: Indeed, there are signs in this, and We always put people to the test.
ja: 本当にその中にはまさしく、御徴[1]がある。そしてわれら*は本当に、試練を課す者[2]であった。
u.src: 23:30  Indeed, there are signs in this, and We always put people to the test.

ja: [1]　この「御徴」は、アッラーの唯一性*、ヌーフ*の正直さ、その民の偽（いつわ）り、及びアッラー*のしもべたちに対するご慈悲を示す、証拠のこと（アッ＝サァディー５５1頁参照）。 [2]　つまり、民を滅ぼす前に使徒*を遣わすことで、その民を試す者ということ（ムヤッサル３４４頁参照）。

p.src: 23:31  Then We raised up after them another generation[9],

en: Then We raised up after them another generation[9],
ja: それからわれら*は、彼ら（ヌーフ*の民）の後、別の世代[1]を設けた。
u.src: 23:31  Then We raised up after them another generation[9],

en: [9] i.e., the people of ‘Aad.
ja: [1]　この「別の世代」とは、アード*のことを指すとされる。また一説には、サムード*のこと（イブン・カスィール５：４７４参照）。

p.src: 23:32  and We sent to them a messenger[10] from among themselves [saying], “Worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”

en: and We sent to them a messenger[10] from among themselves [saying], “Worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”
ja: それで、われら*は彼らに、彼ら自身の内から一人の使徒*を遣わした。（彼は民に、こう言った。）「アッラー*を崇拝*せよ。あなた方には、かれの外に崇拝*すべきいかなるものもないのだから。一体あなた方は（アッラー*に逆らい）畏れ*ないのか？」
u.src: 23:32  and We sent to them a messenger[10] from among themselves [saying], “Worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”

en: [10] i.e., Prophet Hūd, who was sent to the people of ‘Aad.

p.src: 23:33  But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made affluent in the life of this world, said, “He is no more than a man like yourselves; he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.

en: But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made affluent in the life of this world, said, “He is no more than a man like yourselves; he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
ja: 不信仰で、来世における拝謁[1]を嘘呼ばわりし、われらが現世の生活において贅沢を味わわせた、彼の民の有力者らは言った。「これは、あなた方と同様の一人の人間に過ぎない。彼は、あなた方が食べる（同じ）ものから食べ、あなた方が飲む（同じ）ものから飲んでいる。
u.src: 23:33  But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made affluent in the life of this world, said, “He is no more than a man like yourselves; he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.

ja: [1]　「来世における拝謁」とは、復活と清算のこと（アル＝クルトゥビー12：121参照）。

p.src: 23:34  If you obey a man like yourselves, you will surely be losers.

en: If you obey a man like yourselves, you will surely be losers.
ja: そして、もしもあなた方が自分たちと同様の人間に従うならば、そうすれば実にあなた方は、まさしく損失者となってしまうのだ。
u.src: 23:34  If you obey a man like yourselves, you will surely be losers.

p.src: 23:35  Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought forth?

en: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought forth?
ja: 一体、彼（使徒*）は、あなた方が死んで土と骨と化した時、本当にあなた方が（再び生を与えられては墓の中から）出される者になると、あなた方に約束するのか？
u.src: 23:35  Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought forth?

p.src: 23:36  Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are promised![11]

en: Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are promised![11]
ja: あなた方が約束されているものは、あり得ない、あり得ないのだぞ！
u.src: 23:36  Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are promised![11]

en: [11] i.e., How distant and improbable is the resurrection!

p.src: 23:37  There is nothing except our life in this world; we die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.

en: There is nothing except our life in this world; we die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.
ja: それは、現世における私たちの生活に過ぎない[1]。私たちは死に、生き（て、世代を交代し続け）るだけ[2]。そして私たちは、蘇らされる身などではないのだ。
u.src: 23:37  There is nothing except our life in this world; we die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.

ja: [1]　つまり、生とは、自分たちが今いる者だけであり、あなたが約束する来世における復活の後の生などはない、ということ（アル＝クルトゥビー12：12４参照）。 [2]　「私たち」の先祖が死に、「私たち」の子孫が生きること（ムヤッサル３４４頁参照） 。

p.src: 23:38  He is no more than a man who has fabricated lies about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”

en: He is no more than a man who has fabricated lies about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”
ja: 彼はアッラー*に対して嘘をでっち上げた、一人の男に過ぎない。そして私たちは彼のことなど、信じないぞ」。
u.src: 23:38  He is no more than a man who has fabricated lies about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”

p.src: 23:39  Noah said, “My Lord, help me for they have rejected me.”

en: Noah said, “My Lord, help me for they have rejected me.”
ja: 彼（使徒**）は、申し上げた。「我が主*よ、彼らが私を嘘つき呼ばわりしますゆえ、私をお助け下さい」。
u.src: 23:39  Noah said, “My Lord, help me for they have rejected me.”

p.src: 23:40  Allah said, “In a little while they will surely be regretful.”

en: Allah said, “In a little while they will surely be regretful.”
ja: かれは仰せられた。「彼らは必ずやもうすぐ、後悔する者となる」。
u.src: 23:40  Allah said, “In a little while they will surely be regretful.”

p.src: 23:41  So the huge blast[12] overtook them in all justice, and We swept them away like scum[13]. So away with the wrongdoing people!

en: So the huge blast[12] overtook them in all justice, and We swept them away like scum[13]. So away with the wrongdoing people!
ja: （轟く）一声[1]が真理と共に[2]彼らを捕らえ、われら*は彼らを枯れ屑にした。不正*者である民に、滅亡あれ。
u.src: 23:41  So the huge blast[12] overtook them in all justice, and We swept them away like scum[13]. So away with the wrongdoing people!

en:
[12] i.e., a piercing cry.
 [13] Ghutha’ literally means the froth thrown out by flood waters on the banks.
ja: [1]　「（轟く）一声」については、フード*章６７の訳注を参照。 [2]　「真理と共に」とは、不正*ではなく、公正さによって、という意味（アッ＝サァディー５５1頁参照）。

p.src: 23:42  Then We raised after them other generations.

en: Then We raised after them other generations.
ja: それからわれら*は、彼らの後、（また）いくつもの別の世代を設けた。
u.src: 23:42  Then We raised after them other generations.

p.src: 23:43  No nation can bring its appointed time forward, nor can it delay it.

en: No nation can bring its appointed time forward, nor can it delay it.
ja: いかなる共同体も、その（滅亡の）期限に先駆けることもなければ、遅れることもない。
u.src: 23:43  No nation can bring its appointed time forward, nor can it delay it.

p.src: 23:44  Then We sent Our messengers in succession: every time a messenger came to his people, they rejected him. So We destroyed them, one after the others, and made them mere tales[14]. Away with the people who refuse to believe[15]!

en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: every time a messenger came to his people, they rejected him. So We destroyed them, one after the others, and made them mere tales[14]. Away with the people who refuse to believe[15]!
ja: それからわれら*は、われら*の使徒*たちを続けて遣わした。ある共同体にその使徒*が到来するたび、彼ら（共同体の民）は彼（使徒*）を嘘つき呼ばわりした。それでわれら*は、彼らを次から次へと立て続けにし（て滅亡させ）、彼らを（後世へと）語り継がれるものとしたのだ。信仰しない民には、滅亡あれ。
u.src: 23:44  Then We sent Our messengers in succession: every time a messenger came to his people, they rejected him. So We destroyed them, one after the others, and made them mere tales[14]. Away with the people who refuse to believe[15]!

en:
[14] i.e., history or lessons for people.
 [15] i.e., those who refuse to believe in the messengers.

p.src: 23:45  Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs[16] and compelling proof[17]

en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs[16] and compelling proof[17]
ja: それからわれら*は、われら*の御徴[1]と紛れもなき証拠[2]と共に、ムーサー*とその兄ハールーン*を遣わした。
u.src: 23:45  Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs[16] and compelling proof[17]

en:
[16] Allah sent them both with nine clear signs or miracles: the staff turning into a snake, the bright hand, famine, shortage of crops, floods, locusts, lice, frogs, and blood.
 [17] i.e., compelling proof that they were Allah’s messengers.
ja: [1]　この「御徴」については、雌牛章９2「明証」の訳注を参照。 [2]　この「紛れもなき証拠」については、婦人章1５３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:46  to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they showed arrogance and were haughty people.

en: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they showed arrogance and were haughty people.
ja: フィルアウン*とその（民の）有力者に。すると彼らは、（信仰を受け入れることに対して、）奢り高ぶった。彼らはご高慢非道な民であった。
u.src: 23:46  to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they showed arrogance and were haughty people.

p.src: 23:47  They said, “Should we believe in two men like ourselves when their people are our slaves?”

en: They said, “Should we believe in two men like ourselves when their people are our slaves?”
ja: また、彼ら（フィルアウン*たち）は言った。「一体私たちが、私たちと同様の二人の人間を信じるとでも？彼らの民（イスラーイールの子ら*）は、私たちの奴隷*だというのに[1]」。
u.src: 23:47  They said, “Should we believe in two men like ourselves when their people are our slaves?”

ja: [1]　雌牛章４９とその訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:48  So they rejected them both and were among those who were destroyed.

en: So they rejected them both and were among those who were destroyed.
ja: そして彼らは二人を嘘つき呼ばわりし、滅亡する者の類いとなった。
u.src: 23:48  So they rejected them both and were among those who were destroyed.

p.src: 23:49  We gave Moses the Scripture so that they[18] might be guided.

en: We gave Moses the Scripture so that they[18] might be guided.
ja: また、われら*は確かに、彼らが導かれるようにと、ムーサー*に啓典（トーラー*）を授けた。
u.src: 23:49  We gave Moses the Scripture so that they[18] might be guided.

en: [18] i.e., the Children of Israel.

p.src: 23:50  We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign[19] and sheltered them on a hillside – a place of rest and a flowing stream[20].

en: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign[19] and sheltered them on a hillside – a place of rest and a flowing stream[20].
ja: また、われら*マルヤム*の息子（イーサー*）とその母親を、一つの御徴[1]とした。そして二人を安住と水の流れる台地に住まわせた[2]。
u.src: 23:50  We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign[19] and sheltered them on a hillside – a place of rest and a flowing stream[20].

en:
[19] The miraculous birth of Jesus is clear proof of Allah's Omnipotence that Mary gave birth to him without male interference.
 [20] Other Prophets were rejected for being human beings; whereas, people went to two extremes regarding Jesus: some considered him as divine, while some others went to the other extreme by accusing Mary of unchastity, although they were witnesses of the miraculous birth of Jesus and had heard him speak in the cradle.
ja: [1]　この「御徴」については、マルヤム*章21の訳注を参照。 [2]　一説にこれは、マルヤム*がイーサー*を身ごもった時、身を寄せた場所のこと（アッ＝サァディー５５３頁参照）。 マルヤム*章22－2５を参照。

p.src: 23:51  O messengers[21], eat from the lawful things[22] and act righteously, for I am All-Knowing of what you do.

en: O messengers[21], eat from the lawful things[22] and act righteously, for I am All-Knowing of what you do.
ja: 使徒*たちよ、善きものの内から食べ、正しい行い*を行え[1]。本当にわれは、あなた方が行うことを知って（おり、それで報）いるのだから。
u.src: 23:51  O messengers[21], eat from the lawful things[22] and act righteously, for I am All-Knowing of what you do.

en: [21] In this verse, all of the messengers have been addressed together, which indicates that they all belonged to the same community and their message was one. [22] They must be wholesome and earned in lawful ways.
ja: [1]　合法なものを摂取（せっしゅ）することは、正しい行い*への助力となる。一方で、非合法なものの摂取は、有害さを招く（ムヤッサル３４５頁参照）。そしてその害の一つが、祈りが叶（かな）えられなくなることである（ムスリム*「浄財*の書」６５も参照）。

p.src: 23:52  Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion[23], and I am your Lord, so fear Me.

en: Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion[23], and I am your Lord, so fear Me.
ja: また（預言者*たちよ）、まさにこれ（あなた方の宗教）は、一つの宗教である、あなた方の宗教（イスラーム*）。そしてわれは、あなた方の主*なのだ。ゆえに、われを畏れ*よ。
u.src: 23:52  Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion[23], and I am your Lord, so fear Me.

en: [23] i.e., the religion of Islam, which is submission to the will of Allah.

p.src: 23:53  But people split up their religion into factions, each faction rejoicing in what it has[24].

en: But people split up their religion into factions, each faction rejoicing in what it has[24].
ja: （その後）彼ら（人々）は、自分たちの（宗教上の）事柄において、互いに派を作って分裂してしまった。各派は、自分たちのもの（宗教）に有頂天でいる[1]
u.src: 23:53  But people split up their religion into factions, each faction rejoicing in what it has[24].

en: [24] Of beliefs, opinions, and customs.
ja: [1]　つまり、（イスラーム*のもとに）団結を命じられた後に分裂し、各々の宗教が真理で、他の宗教が嘘だとし、そのことに喜んでいる状態（ムヤッサル３４５頁参照）。

p.src: 23:54  So leave them in their heedlessness for a while.

en: So leave them in their heedlessness for a while.
ja: ならば（使徒*よ、）彼らをしばらく、彼らの（迷いと無知の）奥底につかり切ったままにしておけ。
u.src: 23:54  So leave them in their heedlessness for a while.

p.src: 23:55  Do they think that what We give them wealth and children,

en: Do they think that what We give them wealth and children,
ja: 一体彼らは、思い込んでいるのか？われら*が（現世において）彼らに増やしてやる財産や子供、
u.src: 23:55  Do they think that what We give them wealth and children,

p.src: 23:56  that We hasten to them all that is good? No, but they do not perceive it[25].

en: that We hasten to them all that is good? No, but they do not perceive it[25].
ja: （それらによって）われら*が彼らのため、善に急いでいると？いや、（それは彼らの試練なのだが、）彼らは気付いていないのだ。[1]
u.src: 23:56  that We hasten to them all that is good? No, but they do not perceive it[25].

en: [25] They do not perceive that the good things given to them in this world are but a trial for them to increase in sin and disobedience.
ja: [1]　同様のアーヤ*として、イムラーン家章1７８、悔悟章５５も参照。

p.src: 23:57  Those who are in awe for fear of their Lord[26],

en: Those who are in awe for fear of their Lord[26],
ja: 本当に、自分たちの主*への恐れだけから、（かれの罰に）怯える者たち。[1]
u.src: 23:57  Those who are in awe for fear of their Lord[26],

en: [26] In spite of their faith and righteousness, they are in awe of their Lord.
ja: [1]　彼らは善を尽くし、信仰し、正しい行い*に励みつつも、アッラー*を恐れるものたちである。アル＝ハサン*は言った。「実に信仰者とは、善を尽くしつつも怯えるもの。そして実に偽信者*とは、悪行を犯しつつ安心しているものである」（イブン・カスィール５：４８０参照）。

p.src: 23:58  and those who believe in the verses of their Lord,

en: and those who believe in the verses of their Lord,
ja: また、自分たちの主*の御徴こそ、固く信じる者たち。
u.src: 23:58  and those who believe in the verses of their Lord,

p.src: 23:59  and those who do not associate partners with their Lord,

en: and those who do not associate partners with their Lord,
ja: また、自分たちの主*に対し、決してシルク*を犯さない者たち。
u.src: 23:59  and those who do not associate partners with their Lord,

p.src: 23:60  and those who do whatever [good] they do with their hearts fearful[27], knowing that they will return to their Lord –

en: and those who do whatever [good] they do with their hearts fearful[27], knowing that they will return to their Lord –
ja: また、自分たちの主*の御許に戻る身であるがゆえに、心慄きつつ与える（べき）ものを与える者たち。[1]
u.src: 23:60  and those who do whatever [good] they do with their hearts fearful[27], knowing that they will return to their Lord –

en: [27] That their deeds may not be acceptable.
ja: [1]　つまり善行に励みつつも、それが受け入れられず、復活の日*に自分の役に立たないかもしれないことを恐れる者たちのこと（ムヤッサル３４６頁参照）。

p.src: 23:61  it is they who hasten to do good deeds, and they are foremost in them.

en: it is they who hasten to do good deeds, and they are foremost in them.
ja: それらの者たちは、我先にと、善[1]において競い合っているのだ。
u.src: 23:61  it is they who hasten to do good deeds, and they are foremost in them.

ja: [1]　この「善」とは、アッラー*への服従行為、正しい行為のこと（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 23:62  We do not burden a soul more than what it can bear. We have a Record [of their deeds][28] that tells the truth, and none will be wronged[29].

en: We do not burden a soul more than what it can bear. We have a Record [of their deeds][28] that tells the truth, and none will be wronged[29].
ja: また、われら*はいかなる者にも、その能力以上のものを課したりはしない。そしてわれら*の御許には、真理を語る書[1]があるのであり、彼らが不正*を被ることもない。
u.src: 23:62  We do not burden a soul more than what it can bear. We have a Record [of their deeds][28] that tells the truth, and none will be wronged[29].

en: [28] It records every word he utters and every act he does. [29] By wrongfully punishing someone or diminishing the reward of those who did good.
ja: [1]　これは天使*たちによって、しもべたちの行いが記録された帳簿のこと。一説には、守られし碑板*のこと（アル＝クルトゥビー12：1３４参照）。

p.src: 23:63  But their hearts are oblivious to this[30], and they have other [evil] deeds that they are doing.

en: But their hearts are oblivious to this[30], and they have other [evil] deeds that they are doing.
ja: いや、彼らの心はこれ（クルアーン*）から、（迷いによって）すっかり覆われた状態にある。そして彼らには、その外にも、彼らが行っている（悪い）行いがあるのだ[1]。
u.src: 23:63  But their hearts are oblivious to this[30], and they have other [evil] deeds that they are doing.

en: [30] They are heedless of the fact that everything they say or do is recorded in a Record, or that they are heedless of the Qur’an.
ja: [1]　つまり、シルク*以外にも悪い行いがある、という意味（ムヤッサル３４６頁参照）。

p.src: 23:64  But as soon as We seize their affluent ones with punishment[31], they start crying for help.

en: But as soon as We seize their affluent ones with punishment[31], they start crying for help.
ja: やがて、彼らの内の贅沢者たちをわれら*が懲罰[1]で捕えることになれば、どうであろうか、彼らは（助けを求めて）苦しみ喚く。
u.src: 23:64  But as soon as We seize their affluent ones with punishment[31], they start crying for help.

en: [31] On the Day of Judgment.
ja: [1]　この「懲罰」が 、バドルの戦い*での彼らの敗北だとか、あるいはマッカ*を襲った飢饉（ききん）のことであるとかいう説もある（アル＝バガウィー３：３６９参照）。

p.src: 23:65  “Do not cry for help today, for you will receive no help from Us.

en: “Do not cry for help today, for you will receive no help from Us.
ja: 今日、（助けを求めて）苦しみ喚くのではない。本当にあなた方は、われら*（の罰）から助けられることなどないのだから。
u.src: 23:65  “Do not cry for help today, for you will receive no help from Us.

p.src: 23:66  My verses were recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels,

en: My verses were recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels,
ja: わが御徴（アーヤ*）は確かに、あなた方に対して読誦されていた。そしてあなた方は、踵を返して後ずさりしたのである。
u.src: 23:66  My verses were recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels,

p.src: 23:67  feeling proud of this [Sacred House], spending night in evil talks [about the Qur’an].”

en: feeling proud of this [Sacred House], spending night in evil talks [about the Qur’an].”
ja: それ[1]ゆえに驕り高ぶり、夜もすがら悪口に興じつつ[2]。
u.src: 23:67  feeling proud of this [Sacred House], spending night in evil talks [about the Qur’an].”

ja: [1]　「それ」とは、大方の学者によれば、マッカ*のクライシュ族*がその管理を携（たずさ）わっていたカァバ神殿*のこと。彼らはそのことを、鼻にかけていた。また一説には、「それ（クルアーン*）に対して驕り高ぶり・・・」という解釈もある（アル＝クルトゥビー12：1３６参照）。 [2]　詳細にされた章2６、星章５９－６1も参照。

p.src: 23:68  Have they not pondered the Words [of Allah], or has there come to them what did not come to their forefathers?

en: Have they not pondered the Words [of Allah], or has there come to them what did not come to their forefathers?
ja: 一体、彼らはその言葉（クルアーン*）を熟慮しないのか？いや、彼らの昔の先祖たちに訪れなかったものが、彼らのもとに到来した（ことが理由で、信じないという）のか？[1]
u.src: 23:68  Have they not pondered the Words [of Allah], or has there come to them what did not come to their forefathers?

ja: [1]　金の装飾章2３－2４も参照。

p.src: 23:69  Or is it that they do not recognize their Messenger, so they deny him?

en: Or is it that they do not recognize their Messenger, so they deny him?
ja: いや、彼らは自分たちの使徒*（ムハンマド*）を知らず、それで彼を否認するのか？[1]
u.src: 23:69  Or is it that they do not recognize their Messenger, so they deny him?

ja: [1]　実際のところ、彼らは預言者*ムハンマド*が啓示を授かる前から、彼を「誠実な人」という別称で呼ぶほど、彼の善き品性、正直さ、誠実さについて、熟知していた（アッ＝サァディー５５４頁参照）。ユーヌス*章1６の訳注も参照。

p.src: 23:70  Or do they say, “There is madness in him?” Rather, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth.

en: Or do they say, “There is madness in him?” Rather, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth.
ja: いや、彼らは、彼が憑かれている[1]とでも言うのか？いや、彼は彼らのもとに真理を携えてやって来たのだが、彼らの多くは真理を嫌うのである。
u.src: 23:70  Or do they say, “There is madness in him?” Rather, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth.

ja: [1]　アル＝ヒジュラ章６「憑かれた者」に関する訳注も参照。

p.src: 23:71  Were the Truth to follow their desires, the heavens and earth, and all those who are therein would have been ruined. In fact, We have given them their Reminder, but they are averse to their Reminder.

en: Were the Truth to follow their desires, the heavens and earth, and all those who are therein would have been ruined. In fact, We have given them their Reminder, but they are averse to their Reminder.
ja: もし真理が彼らの欲望に従うようなことがあれば、諸天と大地、そこにあるものは、損なわれてしまったであろう。いや、われら*は彼らに、彼らの栄誉[1]をもたらした。そして彼らは自分たちの栄誉に対し、背を向けているのだ。
u.src: 23:71  Were the Truth to follow their desires, the heavens and earth, and all those who are therein would have been ruined. In fact, We have given them their Reminder, but they are averse to their Reminder.

ja: [1]　「栄誉（ズィクル）」には、彼らへの「教訓」という意味も含まれ、いずれにせよクルアーン*のことを指す。彼らがその教えを実践する限りにおいて、それは彼らにとっての栄誉となる（前掲書、同頁参照）。預言者*たち章1０、金の装飾章４４も参照。

p.src: 23:72  Or do you ask them for some reward[32]? But the reward of your Lord is best[33], and He is the Best of Providers.

en: Or do you ask them for some reward[32]? But the reward of your Lord is best[33], and He is the Best of Providers.
ja: いや、（使徒*よ、）あなたは、彼らに見返りを要求[1]（し、それゆえに彼らは信仰を拒否）するのか？（いや、違う、）というのも、あなたの主*の見返りの方が、より善いのだから。そしてかれは、最もよく糧を授けられるお方なのだ。
u.src: 23:72  Or do you ask them for some reward[32]? But the reward of your Lord is best[33], and He is the Best of Providers.

en:
[32] Which did not actually happen.
 [33] This was another proof of the Prophet’s prophethood, for he was conveying the message without demanding any recompense for it; rather, he staked his peaceful life and relationships with his people for accomplishing his mission.
ja: [1]　この「見返りの要求」については、ユーヌス*章７2の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:73  Indeed, you are calling them to a straight path,

en: Indeed, you are calling them to a straight path,
ja: 本当にあなたは、彼らをまさに、まっすぐな道（イスラーム*）へと招いているのである。
u.src: 23:73  Indeed, you are calling them to a straight path,

p.src: 23:74  but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from that path.

en: but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from that path.
ja: そして本当に、来世を信じない者たちは、（正しい）道からまさに外れてしまっている者たちなのだ。
u.src: 23:74  but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from that path.

p.src: 23:75  Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve their adversity[34], they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

en: Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve their adversity[34], they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
ja: もし、われら*が彼らに慈悲をかけ、彼らの害を取り除いてやったら[1]、彼らは彷徨いつつ、自らのひどい放埓さに固執したであろう。
u.src: 23:75  Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve their adversity[34], they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

en: [34] It refers to the famine which occurred in Makkah some time after the advent of prophethood.
ja: [1]　一説に、これは「地獄に入れずに現世に返してやり、（再び）試すこと」。または「旱魃（かんばつ）や飢餓（きが）」（アル＝クルトゥビー12：1４2参照）。

p.src: 23:76  We have already seized them with punishment, but they did not humble themselves to their Lord, nor did they supplicate in humility,

en: We have already seized them with punishment, but they did not humble themselves to their Lord, nor did they supplicate in humility,
ja: われら*は確かに、彼らを懲罰[1]で捕えた。そして彼らは自分たちの主*に従順になることもなかったし、おそれ畏まりもしない。
u.src: 23:76  We have already seized them with punishment, but they did not humble themselves to their Lord, nor did they supplicate in humility,

ja: [1]　この「懲罰」とは、試練としての災（わざわ）い のこと（ムヤッサル３４７頁参照）。一説には、マッカ*の民を苦しめた七年間の大飢饉（ききん）のこと（アン＝ナサーイー11３５2参照）。

p.src: 23:77  until when We open for them a gateway of severe punishment, they will be plunged into utter despair.

en: until when We open for them a gateway of severe punishment, they will be plunged into utter despair.
ja: やがて、われら*が彼らに対して厳しい懲罰[1]の扉を開ける時、どうであろう、彼らはその中で落胆する者となる。
u.src: 23:77  until when We open for them a gateway of severe punishment, they will be plunged into utter despair.

ja: [1]　この「懲罰」は、来世での懲罰のこととされる（ムヤッサル３４７頁参照） 。

p.src: 23:78  It is He Who gave you hearing, sight and hearts. How little you give thanks[35]!

en: It is He Who gave you hearing, sight and hearts. How little you give thanks[35]!
ja: かれは、あなた方に聴覚と視覚と心を備え付けて下さったお方。あなた方が感謝することの少ないこと。
u.src: 23:78  It is He Who gave you hearing, sight and hearts. How little you give thanks[35]!

en: [35] The disbelievers, instead of showing gratefulness for the blessings of eyes, ears, mind, and heart; show ingratitude to their Creator.

p.src: 23:79  And it is He Who spread you on earth, and to Him you will all be gathered.

en: And it is He Who spread you on earth, and to Him you will all be gathered.
ja: また、かれは、あなた方を大地に繁茂させられたお方。そしてかれの御許にこそ、あなた方は召集されるのだ。
u.src: 23:79  And it is He Who spread you on earth, and to Him you will all be gathered.

p.src: 23:80  It is He Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of night and day[36]. Do you not understand?

en: It is He Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of night and day[36]. Do you not understand?
ja: そして、かれは生を与えられ、死を与えられるお方。またかれにこそ、夜と昼の交代は属する。一体あなた方は、分別しないのか？
u.src: 23:80  It is He Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of night and day[36]. Do you not understand?

en: [36] The One Who possesses all these powers is the only One worthy of worship without any partners with Him.

p.src: 23:81  But[37] they say the like of what the earlier peoples said.

en: But[37] they say the like of what the earlier peoples said.
ja: いや、彼らは昔の人々が言ったのと同じようなことを言った。
u.src: 23:81  But[37] they say the like of what the earlier peoples said.

en: [37] Instead of using their understanding and reason.

p.src: 23:82  They say, “Is it that when we die and become dust and bones, will we really be resurrected[38]?

en: They say, “Is it that when we die and become dust and bones, will we really be resurrected[38]?
ja: 彼らは言ったのだ。「一体、死んで土と骨と化した後で、本当に私たちが蘇らされる身であるなどというのか？
u.src: 23:82  They say, “Is it that when we die and become dust and bones, will we really be resurrected[38]?

en: [38] The One Who created the earth and everything on it from nothing, it is easy for Him to re-create them once again.

p.src: 23:83  This is what we and our forefathers were promised before; this is nothing but ancient fables.”

en: This is what we and our forefathers were promised before; this is nothing but ancient fables.”
ja: 私たちと、私たちのご先祖様たちは以前、確かにこれ[1]を約束されたのである。これは昔の人々のお伽噺に外ならない」。
u.src: 23:83  This is what we and our forefathers were promised before; this is nothing but ancient fables.”

ja: [1]　「これ」とは、復活のこととされる。つまり、「ご先祖様の代から、復活のことを耳にしたきたが、それはまだ起こらないではないか？」という当てこすり（アッ＝サァディー５５７頁参照）。

p.src: 23:84  Say, “To whom belong the earth and all those who are on it, if you really know?”

en: Say, “To whom belong the earth and all those who are on it, if you really know?”
ja: （使徒*よ、）言ってやれ。「大地と、そこにあるものは誰のものか？もし、あなた方が知っているのであれば」。
u.src: 23:84  Say, “To whom belong the earth and all those who are on it, if you really know?”

p.src: 23:85  They will say, “To Allah.” Say, “Will you not then take heed?”

en: They will say, “To Allah.” Say, “Will you not then take heed?”
ja: 彼らは言うであろう。「アッラー*のものである」。言ってやるのだ。「一体、あなた方は教訓を得ないのか？」
u.src: 23:85  They will say, “To Allah.” Say, “Will you not then take heed?”

p.src: 23:86  Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”

en: Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”
ja: 言ってやれ。「七層の天の主*と、偉大なる御座[1]の主*は誰か？」
u.src: 23:86  Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”

ja: [1]　「御座」については、高壁章５４の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:87  They will say, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear Him?”

en: They will say, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear Him?”
ja: 彼らは言うであろう。「（それらは）アッラー*のものである」。言ってやるのだ。「一体、あなた方は畏れ*ないのか？」
u.src: 23:87  They will say, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear Him?”

p.src: 23:88  Say, “In Whose Hand is the dominion of all things – and He gives protection while none can protect against Him – if you really know?”

en: Say, “In Whose Hand is the dominion of all things – and He gives protection while none can protect against Him – if you really know?”
ja: 言ってやれ。「その御手に全てのものの絶対なる王権があり、そして（援助を求める者を）お助けになり、かれ（の意）に反しては（誰も）助けられることがないお方は、誰か？もし、あなた方が知っているのならば」。
u.src: 23:88  Say, “In Whose Hand is the dominion of all things – and He gives protection while none can protect against Him – if you really know?”

p.src: 23:89  They will say, “Allah.” Say, “Then how can you be deluded?”

en: They will say, “Allah.” Say, “Then how can you be deluded?”
ja: 彼らは言うであろう。「（それらは全て、）アッラー*のものである」。言ってやるのだ。「ならば一体、あなた方はどうしてまやかされるのか？」
u.src: 23:89  They will say, “Allah.” Say, “Then how can you be deluded?”

p.src: 23:90  In fact, We brought them the truth, but they are certainly liars[39].

en: In fact, We brought them the truth, but they are certainly liars[39].
ja: いや、われら*は彼らに真理をもたらした。本当に彼らはまさしく、嘘つきだったのだ。
u.src: 23:90  In fact, We brought them the truth, but they are certainly liars[39].

en: [39] For claiming that Allah has partners and offspring, and that there is no life after death.

p.src: 23:91  Allah has never begotten a son, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he had created, and each would have tried to gain supremacy over the other[40]. Glory be to Allah far above what they ascribe to Him!

en: Allah has never begotten a son, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he had created, and each would have tried to gain supremacy over the other[40]. Glory be to Allah far above what they ascribe to Him!
ja: アッラー*は御子など設けてはおられないし、かれと共にある神[1]なども一切ない。（もし）そうならば、きっと全ての神は自らが創ったものと共に（銘々に）去ってしまい、彼らは互いに君臨し（ようとし合っ）たであろう[2]。彼らの言うようなこと[3]から（無縁な）、アッラー*に称え*あれ[4]。
u.src: 23:91  Allah has never begotten a son, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he had created, and each would have tried to gain supremacy over the other[40]. Glory be to Allah far above what they ascribe to Him!

en: [40] Then there would have been serious conflicts and wars among different sovereigns and gods.
ja: [1]　「神」に関しては、雌牛章1３３の訳注を参照。 [2]　全能である真の神が二つ以上あったとしたら、世界の秩序は無茶苦茶になってしまう。しかし実際のところ、この宇宙は太古の昔から、あらゆる被造物の福利を実現しつつ、いかなる不具合や矛盾（むじゅん）もなく、驚くべき秩序を保ち続けてきた（アッ＝サァディー５５８頁参照）。 [3]　つまり、シルク*や、嘘つき呼ばわりすることなど（ムヤッサル３４８頁参照）。 [4]　雌牛章11６の訳注も参照。

p.src: 23:92  Knower of the unseen and the seen. Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him!

en: Knower of the unseen and the seen. Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him!
ja: （かれは）不可視の世界*と現象界[1]をご存知になるお方で、彼らがシルク*を犯しているものから、（無縁で）高遠なお方。
u.src: 23:92  Knower of the unseen and the seen. Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him!

ja: [1]　「現象界」については、家畜章７３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:93  Say, “My Lord, if You show me what they[41] are warned of,

en: Say, “My Lord, if You show me what they[41] are warned of,
ja: （使徒*よ、）言うがよい。「我が主よ、もしもあなたが私に、彼らが約束されているもの[1]をまさにお見せになるとしても、
u.src: 23:93  Say, “My Lord, if You show me what they[41] are warned of,

en: [41] i.e., the pagans of Makkah.
ja: [1]　「われら*が約束しているもの」とは、懲罰のこと（ムヤッサル３４８頁参照）。

p.src: 23:94  my Lord, then do not include me among the wrongdoing people[42].”

en: my Lord, then do not include me among the wrongdoing people[42].”
ja: 我が主*よ、私を不正*者である民の中にはおかないで下さい」。
u.src: 23:94  my Lord, then do not include me among the wrongdoing people[42].”

en: [42] Allah’s punishment should be dreaded by all; when it comes, it does not only destroy the wicked but may also involve the righteous.

p.src: 23:95  We are surely able to show you that of which We have warned them.

en: We are surely able to show you that of which We have warned them.
ja: 本当にわれら*は、我らが彼らに約束しているものをあなたに見せることが、まさしく出来る者なのである。
u.src: 23:95  We are surely able to show you that of which We have warned them.

p.src: 23:96  Repel evil with what is best; We know well what they claim[43].

en: Repel evil with what is best; We know well what they claim[43].
ja: 悪を、より善いものでこそ押しのけよ[1]。われら*は彼らが言うこと[2]を、最もよく知っている。
u.src: 23:96  Repel evil with what is best; We know well what they claim[43].

en: [43] That there are other gods besides Allah, and that the Prophet is a liar, a poet, etc.
ja: [1]　同様のアーヤ*として、詳細にされた章３４－３５も参照。 [2]　アーヤ*９1「彼らが言うようなこと」の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:97  And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the temptations of the devils.

en: And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the temptations of the devils.
ja: また（使徒*よ）、言うがよい。「我が主*よ、私はあなたに、シャイターン*の煽り立てからのご加護を乞います。
u.src: 23:97  And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the temptations of the devils.

p.src: 23:98  And I seek refuge with You, my Lord, that they even come near me.”

en: And I seek refuge with You, my Lord, that they even come near me.”
ja: そして我が主*よ、（何事においても、）彼ら（シャイターン*）が私のところにやって来ることからのご加護を、あなたに乞います。
u.src: 23:98  And I seek refuge with You, my Lord, that they even come near me.”

p.src: 23:99  Until when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back,

en: Until when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back,
ja: やがて、彼らの内の者[1]に死が訪れれば、彼は（こう）言う。「我が主*よ、私を（現世に）返して下さい。
u.src: 23:99  Until when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back,

ja: [1]　これは不信仰者*、あるいはアッラー*のご命令に反していいた者のこと（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 23:100  so that I may do righteous deeds in what I left behind.” No, it is only a word he utters. And behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected[44]

en: so that I may do righteous deeds in what I left behind.” No, it is only a word he utters. And behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected[44]
ja: 私は、自分が残して来たもの[1]において、正しい行い*をするでしょう」。断じて（、戻ることは出来）ない。本当にそれは、彼が（口先だけで）言っている、ただの言葉に過ぎないのだから。そして彼らの先には、彼らが蘇らされる日まで、障壁[2]がある。[3]
u.src: 23:100  so that I may do righteous deeds in what I left behind.” No, it is only a word he utters. And behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected[44]

en: [44] i.e., Once they die, there will be no chance of returning to the world, and they shall remain in that state until the Day of Resurrection.
ja: [1]　「残して 来たもの」には、シャハーダ*の言葉、施（ほどこ）すべき財産などといった解釈がある（アル＝クルトゥビー12：1５０参照）。 [2]　この「障壁（バルザフ）」とは、現世と来世の間を分ける障壁のこと。現世でアッラー*に従順であった者は、自分の死から復活の日*までの間、そこで安楽を楽しみ、反抗的であった者は、そこで罰され続ける（アッ＝サァディー５５９頁参照）。 [3]　いざ復活の日*（あるいは死）が到来すると、彼らは現世での猶予（ゆうよ）を求めたり、自分たちを現世に返してくれることを頼んだりする。だがもちろん、それは叶（かな）わない。家畜章2７－2８、高壁章５３、イブラーヒーム*章４４、アッ＝サジダ*章12、創成者*章３７、赦し深いお方章11－12、相談章４４、偽信者*たち章1０－11も参照。

p.src: 23:101  When the Trumpet is blown[45], there will be no kinship ties between them on that Day, nor will they ask about one another[46].

en: When the Trumpet is blown[45], there will be no kinship ties between them on that Day, nor will they ask about one another[46].
ja: 角笛に吹き込まれれば[1]、その日、彼らの間には血縁（の自慢）などもなければ、互いに（安否を）尋ね合うこともない。[2]
u.src: 23:101  When the Trumpet is blown[45], there will be no kinship ties between them on that Day, nor will they ask about one another[46].

en:
[45] When the Trumpet is blown on the Day of Resurrection by an angel, everyone on earth will die. Then it will be blown a second time, and all will raise for Judgment. See 39:68.
 [46] For everyone will be worried and anxious about his own plight.
ja: [1]　「角笛に吹き込まれる」については、家畜章７３の訳注を参照。 [2]　階段章1０－1４、眉をひそめて章３４－３７も参照。

p.src: 23:102  So those whose scales [of good deeds] are heavy, it is they who will be successful.

en: So those whose scales [of good deeds] are heavy, it is they who will be successful.
ja: それで、その（善行の）秤が重かった者、それらの者たちこそは成功者。
u.src: 23:102  So those whose scales [of good deeds] are heavy, it is they who will be successful.

p.src: 23:103  But those whose scales are light, they are the ones who have lost their souls, abiding in Hell forever.

en: But those whose scales are light, they are the ones who have lost their souls, abiding in Hell forever.
ja: そして、その秤が軽かった者、それらの者たちは、自らを損ねた者たちであり、地獄に永遠に留まる。
u.src: 23:103  But those whose scales are light, they are the ones who have lost their souls, abiding in Hell forever.

p.src: 23:104  The Fire will scorch their faces, leaving them disfigured[47].

en: The Fire will scorch their faces, leaving them disfigured[47].
ja: 業火が彼らの顔を焼き焦がし、彼らはそこで（苦痛ゆえに）歯を剥き出す。
u.src: 23:104  The Fire will scorch their faces, leaving them disfigured[47].

en: [47] Kālih means a face whose skin has been removed by scorching until the jaws are exposed.

p.src: 23:105  “Were not My verses recited to you, and you used to reject them?”

en: “Were not My verses recited to you, and you used to reject them?”
ja: （アッラー*は彼らに、こう仰せられる。）「あなた方には（現世で）、わが御徴が誦まれていたのではないのか？そしてあなた方は、それを嘘呼ばわりしていたのでは？」
u.src: 23:105  “Were not My verses recited to you, and you used to reject them?”

p.src: 23:106  They will say, “Our Lord, our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we were a people who went astray.

en: They will say, “Our Lord, our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we were a people who went astray.
ja: 彼らは申し上げる。「我らが主*よ、私たちの不幸が、私たちを制圧してしまったのです。私たちは、迷った民でした。
u.src: 23:106  They will say, “Our Lord, our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we were a people who went astray.

p.src: 23:107  Our Lord, take us out of this; if we returned [to evil], we would certainly be wrongdoers.”

en: Our Lord, take us out of this; if we returned [to evil], we would certainly be wrongdoers.”
ja: 我らが主*よ、私たちをここから出して下さい。そしてもし、（再び迷妄へと）戻ってしまったら、本当に私たちは（真に懲罰に値する）不正*者です」。
u.src: 23:107  Our Lord, take us out of this; if we returned [to evil], we would certainly be wrongdoers.”

p.src: 23:108  Allah will say, “Stay therein despised and do not speak to Me[48].

en: Allah will say, “Stay therein despised and do not speak to Me[48].
ja: かれは仰せられる。「そこに、（惨めなまま）下がっていよ。そしてわれに（これ以上）、話しかけるのではない」。
u.src: 23:108  Allah will say, “Stay therein despised and do not speak to Me[48].

en: [48] i.e., Do not plead your case with Me.

p.src: 23:109  There was a group of My slaves who used to pray, ‘Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.’

en: There was a group of My slaves who used to pray, ‘Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.’
ja: 本当に、わが僕たちの（信仰者の）一団は、（現世でこう）言っていたものなのだ。「我らが主*よ、私たちは信じました。ならば、私たちをお赦しになり、私たちにご慈悲をおかけ下さい。あなたは慈しみ深い者の中でも、最善のお方です」。[1]
u.src: 23:109  There was a group of My slaves who used to pray, ‘Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.’

ja: [1]　彼らは、以下のことを結集した者たちであった：①信仰と、それが要求する正しい行い*。②主*からのお赦しと、ご慈悲の祈願。③アッラー*を主*と認めつつ、信仰というお恵みをかれから頂いたこと、及びかれの豊かなご慈悲と善を告白することを、祈願が叶（かな）えられるための一手段とすること（アッ＝サァディー５６０頁参照）。アーヤ*５７－６1とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 23:110  But you took them in mockery until they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

en: But you took them in mockery until they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
ja: そしてあなた方（不信仰者*）は彼らを、あなた方にわが教訓を忘れさせるほどにまで侮蔑の的とし[1]、彼らを嘲り笑っていたのだ。
u.src: 23:110  But you took them in mockery until they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

ja: [1]　他人の侮蔑に勤しむことは、教訓を忘れることにつながる。そして教訓を忘れているがゆえに、他人の侮蔑（ぶべつ）に勤（いそ）しむのである（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 23:111  I have rewarded them Today for their patience; it is they who are the successful.”

en: I have rewarded them Today for their patience; it is they who are the successful.”
ja: 本当にわれはこの日、彼らが（現世で）忍耐*していたことゆえに、彼らこそを成功者とすることで、彼らに報いてやるのだ。
u.src: 23:111  I have rewarded them Today for their patience; it is they who are the successful.”

p.src: 23:112  He will say, “How many years did you stay on earth?”

en: He will say, “How many years did you stay on earth?”
ja: かれ（アッラー*）は、（地獄の民に）仰せられる。「あなた方は地上で、何年間過ごしたのか？」[1]
u.src: 23:112  He will say, “How many years did you stay on earth?”

ja: [1]　食卓章1０９の、復活の日*における質問についての訳注も参照。

p.src: 23:113  They will say, “We stayed for a day or part of a day; ask those who keep count.”[49]

en: They will say, “We stayed for a day or part of a day; ask those who keep count.”[49]
ja: 彼らは（応えて）申し上げる。「一日か、一日足らずを、過ごしました。ならば、数える者たち[1]にお尋ねください」。
u.src: 23:113  They will say, “We stayed for a day or part of a day; ask those who keep count.”[49]

en: [49] Compared to the duration and misery of their stay in Hell, their life in this world will seem extremely short to them.
ja: [1]　「数える者たち」とは、計算に長じた者たち、あるいは人の行いを記録し、数える天使*たちのこと（アル＝クルトゥビー12：1５６参照）。

p.src: 23:114  Allah will say, “You only stayed for a while, if only you had known[50].

en: Allah will say, “You only stayed for a while, if only you had known[50].
ja: かれは仰せられる。「あなた方は（現世で）、僅かばかりしか過ごしてはいなかった。もし、あなた方が知っていたならば[1]。[2]
u.src: 23:114  Allah will say, “You only stayed for a while, if only you had known[50].

en: [50] That the life of this world was transitory and was a test, but you did not realize it.
ja: [1]　現世が短いことを知っていたら、来世よりも現世を優先させることなく、自分たちの益となることを行い、損となるようなことは行わなかっただろう、ということ（アッ＝シャルビーニー2：４６７参照）。 [2]　同様のアーヤ*として、ユーヌス*章４５、ター・ハー章1０３、ビサンチン章５５、砂丘章３５、引き離すもの章４６も参照。

p.src: 23:115  Did you think that We created you with no purpose and that you would not be brought back to Us?”

en: Did you think that We created you with no purpose and that you would not be brought back to Us?”
ja: 一体あなた方は、われら*があなた方を無意味に創造したと、そしてあなた方が（清算と報いのため）われら*の御許へと戻らされないとでも、思っていたのか？」
u.src: 23:115  Did you think that We created you with no purpose and that you would not be brought back to Us?”

p.src: 23:116  Exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign[51]! None has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Lord of the Honorable Throne.

en: Exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign[51]! None has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Lord of the Honorable Throne.
ja: 王であり、真理であられるアッラー*は、（そのような無意味な行いから）高遠なお方。貴い御座[1]の主*、かれの外に（真に）崇拝*すべきものはない。
u.src: 23:116  Exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign[51]! None has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Lord of the Honorable Throne.

en: [51] The One Who owns everything in existence.
ja: [1]　「御座」については、高壁章５４の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:117  Whoever invokes another god besides Allah, for which he has no proof, his reckoning will be with his Lord[52]. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed.

en: Whoever invokes another god besides Allah, for which he has no proof, his reckoning will be with his Lord[52]. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed.
ja: 誰であろうと、アッラー*に並べて別の神[1]を祈る者ーー彼にはそれ（を祈る正当性）において、いかなる根拠もないのだがーー、その清算は、その主*の御許にこそある。本当に不信仰者*らは、成功することがない。
u.src: 23:117  Whoever invokes another god besides Allah, for which he has no proof, his reckoning will be with his Lord[52]. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed.

en: [52] i.e., he cannot escape His accountability.
ja: [1]　「神」に関しては、雌牛章1３３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 23:118  Say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and you are the Best of those who show mercy.”

en: Say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and you are the Best of those who show mercy.”
ja: （預言者*よ、）言うのだ。「我が主*よ、お赦しになり、ご慈悲をおかけ下さい。そしてあなたは、慈しみ深い者の中でも最善のお方です」。
u.src: 23:118  Say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and you are the Best of those who show mercy.”
